create_event_logger: create an EventLogger instance to log events via the tmetry interface
add_writer_to_logger: add a TmetryWriter instance to the EventLogger for writing event records
add_key_to_event: add a single key-value pair to the current event record on the logger
add_keys_to_event: add multiple key-value pairs at once to the current event record on the logger
log_event_with_topic: log the current event record to all writers under a specified topic
